affectedPublicSurfaces: demo.app-juli.com new run route (apps/demo/src/app — dedicated per-run page)
demo.app-juli.com Decisions tab (must remain working; the new route is additive)

candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: Load the candidate demo build — zero public canary traffic; the run view renders reducer output from a captured scenario and performs no marketplace write
candidateVerificationJourney.notes: Issue's own Release evidence section: 'open a replay run, walk forward to the live edge, back to a frozen stage, and confirm a future stage is unreachable.' Transcribed verbatim; no additional surfaces inferred.

journeys.name: walk-forward-to-live-edge
assertions: approving navigates to the dedicated run route
the six stages render in PUI-DESIGN.md §2 order: Phân tích, Thông tin sản phẩm, SEO, Đề xuất, Cập nhật, Hoàn tất
one stage owns the canvas at a time; a thinking state is a state of a stage, not a separate screen
the bound product is visible at the product-snapshot stage
no tool name, playbook key, or raw error structure appears in rendered output

journeys.name: frozen-past-and-locked-future
assertions: back-navigation to a completed stage shows it frozen — no live updates land in it
returning to the live edge is one action
a stage beyond the live edge is unreachable by click, by keyboard, and by direct URL

journeys.name: finished-run-reopens-fully-frozen
assertions: a finished run opened from scratch renders every stage frozen
the terminal stage shows the run's actual outcome, not a state dressed as another

journeys.name: decisions-tab-unaffected
assertions: the Decisions tab works with the new route absent — the route is additive, which is also the rollback assertion

staticAssetChecks.notes: Issue text: 'the new route must be present in the built output — assert the route file exists in the artifact, the failure mode being a next-start 500 on missing chunks.' Read the built artifact, not the source tree.

migrationCompatibility.notes: Issue text: 'No migration.' A new client route in apps/demo rendering reducer output — no database schema, no persisted-shape change.

rollbackAssertion.notes: Issue text: 'the route is additive; assert the Decisions tab still works without it.' Removing the route must not degrade the Decisions surface.

doNotInfer: release evidence fields beyond what the issue's Release evidence (ADR-035) section states
stage content the reducer did not produce — the canvas renders what the events said and nothing it computed itself
a stage order or content mapping that differs from PUI-DESIGN.md §2
hardcoded English placeholder copy — Vietnamese strings come from dictionary.md and new strings land in #1321
a retry-in-place control — ADR-084 decision 6 forbids it, and a new run requires a new approval
motion driven by a bare timer with no event or state transition, and any path without a reduced-motion alternative
